dataset.name: Korthals et al. 2026 smooth-pursuit benchmark
dataset.cohort: all participants in canonical train and test splits

author_directed_exclusion.reason: authors report severe gaze-target misalignment after a break and recommend removing trials 82-144

preprocessing.target_alignment: participant_id + trial_number + trial_time after canonical preprocessing

sampling.method: nearest existing sample to regular within-trial grid; ties resolve to earlier sample
sampling.operation_order: align gaze and target at canonical 1000 Hz, downsample full timeline, then remove retained rows with non-finite gaze coordinates
sampling.rationale: maximum reported actual target speed 8.41 dva/s moves at most 0.1682 dva per 20 ms, below the 0.2-dva stimulus radius and 1.0-dva tracking-window radius

validation.name: EyeLink nine-point validation summaries
validation.trial_mapping: each validation event applies to its recorded following first_trial through last_trial range
validation.quality_filter: none; retain good, fair, and poor validation summaries as measurement uncertainty

aoi.name: target_center_1dva
aoi.interpretation: target-centered tracking window, not the physical stimulus boundary
aoi.rationale: the benchmark target radius is 0.2 dva; prior pursuit-position work reports typical target-center positional errors around 1 dva or less

endpoint.name: paired jumping-minus-moving target-window occupancy
endpoint.trial_estimate: mean AOI membership across retained finite-gaze rows on the fixed 50-Hz grid
endpoint.matched_cell_rule: after the author-directed exclusion, analyze cells containing exactly one moving_circle and one jumping_circle trial; cells intersecting the declared exclusion may be absent, but any retained trial with zero valid scheduled samples fails closed
endpoint.participant_estimate: unweighted mean of complete matched-cell contrasts
endpoint.estimand_scope: descriptive paired stimulus-pattern contrast; no population p-value or causal claim

error_model.name: grouped isotropic Gaussian from mean radial validation error
error_model.assumption: conditional on the reported mean radial validation error, x and y errors are independent zero-mean Gaussians with common sigma; validation-summary uncertainty, anisotropy, and spatial non-stationarity are not recovered

interpretation.name: measurement-uncertainty sign stability
interpretation.robust_positive: hard effect > 0 and at least 0.95 of Monte Carlo endpoint draws are > 0
interpretation.robust_negative: hard effect < 0 and at least 0.95 of Monte Carlo endpoint draws are < 0
interpretation.measurement_sensitive: all other finite complete outcomes, including a hard effect equal to zero
interpretation.scope: classification is conditional on the frozen dataset, preprocessing, sampling grid, AOI, endpoint, validation grouping, and error-model assumptions
interpretation.population_inference: none; the Monte Carlo interval is measurement-model-induced and is not a population confidence or posterior credible interval
